reason: I already take Toplux and just reorder it when it runs out. $29.99 is more than what I pay now, and I have no reason to switch something that works.
objection: It costs more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and I have never heard of this brand. Why would I pay extra for a box I have to try first?
would_change_my_mind: A price near $20 for the regular box, or seeing that Toplux does not contain what this one does and that matters for me.
